rationale: The agent executed an exchange without first authenticating the user and without obtaining explicit user confirmation before performing an order-changing write, both of which are required by policy. Although the agent appears to have looked up the user by email and accessed orders, there is no evidence of identity verification or of confirmation of the specific exchange details prior to calling exchange_delivered_order_items. The final message states the exchange was already processed, violating the confirm-before-write rule. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
